YiZhe
This notice applies to the YiZhe app and related services. Rights in the YiZhe name, branding, original interface design, text and original features belong to their respective rights holders. Do not impersonate YiZhe or distribute apps or services in a way that falsely implies its approval.

Your content
Rights in text, images, voice messages, videos, files and other content you create or send remain with you or the original rights holder. Ensure that you have permission before sending, forwarding, saving or sharing content, and respect other people's privacy and rights. Using YiZhe does not transfer ownership of your content to YiZhe.

Third-party works
YiZhe uses Element, Matrix and other third-party software components. Their code, fonts, icons and other works belong to their respective rights holders and remain subject to their original licence terms. This notice does not replace or restrict those terms or claim exclusive ownership of third-party works.

Rights enquiries
Use Me → Report a problem to identify potentially infringing content or app materials, their location, the basis of your rights and a way to contact you. Do not include unrelated personal information, account passwords or recovery keys.

Scope
These guidelines cover account access, chats, groups, voice and video calls, file and location sharing, favourites and related features available in the current YiZhe test build. Follow the instructions shown for each feature; features that have not been enabled are not currently available.

Accounts and devices
Protect your credentials, recovery keys and signed-in devices. Do not disclose passwords, verification codes or recovery keys. Invitations, device verification and recovery must be performed by you or an authorised person. Address device access promptly and report lost devices, unexpected sign-ins or impersonation.

Communication and sharing
Use the service lawfully and with the permissions you need. Do not engage in fraud, harassment, threats, impersonation, abusive marketing, malware distribution or violations of privacy, intellectual property or other rights. Group owners and administrators should manage invitations and membership responsibly. Check permissions and recipients before sharing another person's files, location or messages.

Security
Do not steal credentials or keys, forge device identities, bypass access verification or disrupt the service through automated abuse or malicious requests. Report vulnerabilities through Me → Report a problem with the information needed to reproduce them, avoiding other people's sensitive data.

Messages, backup and recovery
Sending, delivery, read status, backup and recovery are distinct states. Refer to the actual status shown in the app. Recall, expiry and cleanup cannot guarantee removal of copies recipients have independently saved or forwarded. Keep your recovery materials safe. Uninstalling, signing out or changing devices does not establish that a backup exists or that all history can be recovered.

Permissions and updates
Camera, microphone, location, notifications and special system access serve their respective features. You can change permissions in system settings; declining an optional permission should not affect unrelated features. Obtain updates through trusted YiZhe channels and complete the required security checks.

Sign-out, deletion and support
Signing out and deleting an account are different actions. Before deletion, read the scope and consequences shown in the confirmation screen and retain information you still need. Rely on the actual operation status while processing is incomplete. Submit usage questions, account disputes, rights concerns or security reports through Me → Report a problem. These guidelines do not exclude your legal rights.

Scope and contact
YiZhe provides this notice for the current test build to explain information involved in its features and the controls available to you. Submit personal-information enquiries through Me → Report a problem and include your preferred contact method. Never include passwords, verification codes, private keys or recovery keys.

Accounts and secure access
Registration, sign-in, device verification and recovery process account identifiers, information you enter, device or installation identifiers, system and app versions, device security proofs, access status and necessary network information. These support account creation, device recognition, access checks and troubleshooting. Security verification and system permission status are different facts.

Chats, calls and profiles
Message synchronisation, contacts, groups, call connections and content display involve account and conversation identifiers, membership, event times, message status, connection information and content you provide. Supported chat content is protected by encryption. Encryption does not hide all service information, such as account relationships, times and connection status. Your avatar, display name and shared content are shown within the relevant sharing scope.

Camera, microphone, files and location
The camera supports scanning, capture and video calls; the microphone supports voice messages and calls. Image, video and file access supports items you choose to send, save or attach to feedback. Location supports sharing you initiate, live location or an explained and authorised one-time device-admission check. Live sharing and the one-time security check are separate features; you can end sharing or change system permissions. Map selection, place search and address lookup use Amap services, which process relevant map requests, search terms, coordinates and necessary network information. Check the selected location before sending.

Notifications, background access and app protection
Notifications involve device push registration, delivery status and necessary notification information. The selected push service and phone system participate in delivery. Background operation, autostart, full-screen calls, overlays and Do Not Disturb access affect alerts according to system settings. App lock may use system authentication. The app uses the authentication result; biometric templates are managed by the operating system.

Backup, favourites and recovery
These features process encrypted backups, recovery status, saved content and synchronisation identifiers when enabled. Recovery depends on account, device and key conditions. Configuring backup does not guarantee that every item will remain recoverable. Protect your recovery materials. Favourites, backups and chat history can have different retention scopes; consult their actual instructions and status.

Feedback and diagnostics
Submitted feedback includes your description, selected attachments and any screenshots, logs or notification settings you choose to include. Logs may contain versions, device, account or conversation identifiers and errors; attachments may contain personal information. Review them before sending. You can change diagnostic options and whether you may be contacted. If usage analysis is offered in this build, decide whether to enable it using the explanation for that option. Feedback uploads and usage analysis are separate operations.

Retention, deletion and protection
Account information supports account and service management. Messages and protected content follow applicable conversation retention rules, expiry and deletion operations. Feedback supports investigation of the reported issue. Retention is limited to what the relevant purpose and applicable requirements need. Deletion can involve local storage, servers, backups and multiple devices; disappearance from a screen does not prove every copy has been removed. Copies independently saved by recipients may be outside YiZhe's control. Encryption, access verification and device protection reduce risks but do not guarantee absolute security or recovery in every circumstance.

Your controls
Edit available profile fields, change system permissions, review recovery and permission status under Chat and security, and use Report a problem to request access, correction, copying, deletion or withdrawal of relevant authorisation. Signing out does not delete your account. Use the separate account-deletion action and read its confirmation. Identity checks may be needed to prevent impersonation.

Other services and changes
External pages, map services and apps you explicitly share to handle received information under their own terms. Read their notices. Changes involving new purposes, permissions or recipients should include appropriate explanations. This notice is available offline and changes with app updates. Material changes should be separately notified.
